title.en: Submit a Morpho Vault V2 market cap increase (curator)
title.zh-TW: 提交 Morpho Vault V2 市場上限的提高（curator）

summary.en: As curator, the Safe calls the vault's `multicall` with two `submit` calls inside: one queues raising the absolute cap of the market you pick to the amount you type, the other raising its relative cap to the percentage you type. This transaction only queues; it does not change the caps. Once the vault's timelock has passed, anyone can execute it. It moves none of the Safe's assets.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 以 curator 身分呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`，裡面兩個 `submit`：一個排隊把你選的市場的絕對上限提高到你填的數量，一個把相對上限提高到你填的百分比。這筆交易只排隊，不改上限；等 vault 的 timelock 過了，任何人都能執行它。不動 Safe 的任何資產。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets how much each market can hold (its cap), and the allocator moves funds within the caps. Raising a cap takes a `submit` first, and it can run only after the timelock has passed.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場能放多少（上限），allocator 在上限內搬錢。提高上限要先 `submit`，等 timelock 過了才能執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 10 audits (Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and one contest).
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 10 份稽核（Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽）。

text.en: Raising a cap is queued, and executing it needs no signature: once the timelock ends, anyone can call `increaseAbsoluteCap` and `increaseRelativeCap` to make it take effect. The contract checks only `executableAt`, not who calls. What really needs your judgment is this `submit`.
text.zh-TW: 提高上限要排隊，執行不用簽：timelock 到期後任何人都能呼叫 `increaseAbsoluteCap` 和 `increaseRelativeCap` 讓它生效，合約只檢查 `executableAt`，不檢查是誰。真正要你判斷的是這筆 `submit`。

recommendation.en: Before signing, confirm that the market and both caps are what you want. After it is sent, you can still cancel it with `revoke` within the timelock.
recommendation.zh-TW: 簽之前確認市場和兩個上限都是你要的；送出後在 timelock 內還能用 `revoke` 取消。

text.en: This template accepts only one market, with one `submit` each for the absolute and the relative cap. That is the most common form over the past year (338 transactions, 28 Safes). Queuing several markets at once, or executing in the same transaction (a vault whose timelock is 0), gets MISMATCH from verify.
text.zh-TW: 這個模板只收一個市場、絕對和相對上限各一個 `submit`，這是過去一年最常見的寫法（338 筆、28 個 Safe）。一次排好幾個市場、或同一筆裡馬上執行（timelock 為 0 的 vault），verify 會判 MISMATCH。

recommendation.en: Queue only one market per transaction. On MISMATCH, do not sign.
recommendation.zh-TW: 一筆只排一個市場；判 MISMATCH 就不要簽。

text.en: AI has no browser that runs JavaScript, so it did not open the market's page on the Morpho app. AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain (market id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64), and the oracle it answers is 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a. The market id is the hash of the five parameters, so a different oracle means a different market.
text.zh-TW: AI 沒有能跑 JavaScript 的瀏覽器，沒打開 Morpho app 的市場頁。AI 在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`（市場 id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64），回答的 oracle 就是 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a；市場 id 是五個參數的 hash，換掉 oracle 就是另一個市場。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To check again, open this market's page on the Morpho app and compare the oracle address.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想再確認就在 Morpho app 打開這個市場頁比對 oracle 地址。

role.en: The vault's asset, also the token the markets lend
role.zh-TW: vault 的資產，也是市場借出的代幣

role.en: Morpho Blue itself; the markets live inside it
role.zh-TW: Morpho Blue 本體，市場在它裡面

role.en: The oracle the market uses to price cbBTC
role.zh-TW: 市場用來給 cbBTC 定價的 oracle

role.en: The factory that creates Vault V2 market adapters. It answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true: it created the adapter
role.zh-TW: 建立 Vault V2 市場轉接合約的工廠，它回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，轉接合約是它建立的

role.en: The collateral token of the USP markets
The oracle the USP markets use to price USP
role.zh-TW: USP 市場用來給 USP 定價的 oracle

role.en: The collateral token of the weETH market
The oracle the weETH market uses to price weETH
role.zh-TW: weETH 市場用來給 weETH 定價的 oracle

1.multicall.data.en: The two calls the vault runs in order, fixed at two items: queue the absolute cap first, then the relative cap. If either fails, the whole transaction fails.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 依序執行的兩個呼叫，固定兩項：先排絕對上限，再排相對上限。任一個失敗，整筆失敗。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: queue an absolute cap increase.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：排隊提高絕對上限。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.en: The full call to queue, listed item by item below. The vault records its `executableAt`; only after that time can this exact call run.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.zh-TW: 要排隊的完整呼叫，下面逐項列出。vault 記下它的 `executableAt`，到期才能執行這一模一樣的呼叫。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "this market in this adapter".
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「這個轉接合約裡的這個市場」。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams: a cap on one market, not on the whole adapter or on a collateral token.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams：單一市場的上限，不是整個轉接合約或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The new absolute cap: the most assets the vault can put into this market. Typing `max` means no absolute cap, relying only on the relative cap.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 新的絕對上限：vault 最多放多少資產進這個市場。打 `max` 等於不設絕對上限，只靠相對上限。

1.multicall.data[1].en: Item 2: queue a relative cap increase.
1.multicall.data[1].zh-TW: 第二項：排隊提高相對上限。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.en: The full call to queue, listed item by item below.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.zh-TW: 要排隊的完整呼叫，下面逐項列出。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The same cap id as item 1.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 跟第一項同一個上限 id。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The market's five parameters, equal to the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，等於你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The new relative cap: the largest share of the vault's total assets this market can hold, where 100% equals 10^18.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 新的相對上限：這個市場最多占 vault 總資產的比例，100% 等於 10^18。
